_comment: Target-state geectl leaves and flags the skill cites before geectl implements them. Each row names the blocking geectl issue (or PR) and the exact shape the skill needs. check-geectl.py verifies citations against this file plus the built geectl binary's --help, and reports a row as stale the moment the binary gains the leaf or flag — remove the row then, and re-verify the citations live. Delete this file when it is empty.
